name: Pidlwick
summary: A little man with a face painted like a jack-o'-lantern, hiding in Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Hid under a guest-room bed with a ticking, beating sound, and shrugged off Malron's attempt to frighten him.
Tried to throw Malron down a hundred-foot drop, then vanished.

name: Masked Servant
summary: A maimed, terrified servant at the reception in Castle Ravenloft.

facts.text: Served the party a purple drink while the vampires drank red wine; his fingers were cut off at the first knuckle.
Spilled red wine on Volenta's white dress and set off a stir.
